response.rationale: “Bangsal” is the ordinary Indonesian term for a hospital ward, while Malaysian Malay ordinarily uses “wad” for the same hospital area where patients stay.
response.shared_synonym_rationale: Phrases such as “ruang rawat inap” may occur in both varieties, but “bangsal” versus “wad” remains a useful Indonesian–Malaysian lexical preference.
